{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 296,
      "where": "Opening formula, target of s under the first colimit",
      "scan": "A_p",
      "tex": "A_{\\sisi{p}{0}}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "A_0",
      "note": "The printed target has index p instead of 0. The TeX corrects it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 297,
      "where": "Paragraph beginning « Il existe un tel objet B », category containing the Ind-object",
      "scan": "\\Aa_0(S^{-1})",
      "tex": "\\Aa_0(S^{-})",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Aa_0(S^{-})",
        "new": "\\Aa_0(S^{-1})"
      },
      "note": "The TeX omits the 1 in the inverse exponent; both scans show −1."
    },
    {
      "page": 298,
      "where": "Theorem 2.3.7, hypothesis on LF_*",
      "scan": "est défini en",
      "tex": "est défini on",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "on $A_0\\in",
        "new": "en $A_0\\in"
      },
      "note": "The printed preposition is « en », not « on »."
    },
    {
      "page": 298,
      "where": "Theorem 2.3.7, category containing A_0 in the hypothesis",
      "scan": "\\Aa(S_0^{-1})",
      "tex": "\\Aa(S^{-1}_0)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Aa_0(S^{-1}_0)",
      "note": "The subscript 0 on the category is missing in print: LF_* has the localized 0-fibre as its domain. The TeX retains the omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 298,
      "where": "Theorem 2.3.7, hypothesis on the right derived functor",
      "scan": "Rf^{\\ast}",
      "tex": "Rf^{\\ast}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "RF^{\\ast}",
      "note": "The functor introduced immediately above is F^*, with capital F, as also used in the displayed formula. The TeX retains the printed lowercase f."
    },
    {
      "page": 298,
      "where": "Theorem 2.3.7, middle Hom in the displayed equality",
      "scan": "\\Hom_{\\Aa_{(S^{-1})}}(A_0,A_1)",
      "tex": "\\Hom_{\\Aa\\sisi{_{(S^{-1})}}{(S^{-1})}}(A_0,A_1)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Hom_{\\Aa(S^{-1})}(A_0,A_1)",
      "note": "The localization argument is incorrectly subscripted to the category in print. The TeX corrects it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 298,
      "where": "End of 2.4.0, reference for a saturated multiplicative system",
      "scan": "[CD 1.2.1]",
      "tex": "\\cite[\\sisi{}{I }1.2.1]{SGA4-17:CD}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\cite[I 1.2.1]{SGA4-17:CD}",
      "note": "The printed reference omits the chapter numeral I. The TeX supplies it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 299,
      "where": "Paragraph defining \\Aa^1, agreement after « images directes »",
      "scan": "images directes sont déployés",
      "tex": "images directes sont\ndéployés",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "images directes sont déployées",
      "note": "The participle should agree with the feminine plural « images directes ». The TeX retains the printed agreement error."
    },
    {
      "page": 299,
      "where": "Paragraph defining \\Aa^1, « foncteurs image directes »",
      "scan": "foncteurs image directes",
      "tex": "foncteurs image directes",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "foncteurs image directe",
      "note": "The name of the operation is « image directe »; the printed plural ending on « directes » is erroneous. The TeX retains it."
    },
    {
      "page": 299,
      "where": "Diagram (2.4.1.2), lower horizontal arrow",
      "scan": "A\\longrightarrow B, without a label",
      "tex": "\\sisi{\\ar[r]}{\\ar[r]_f}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "A\\xrightarrow{f}B",
      "note": "The label f for the given lower arrow is omitted in print. The TeX supplies it with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 300,
      "where": "First diagram, left vertical arrow",
      "scan": "s",
      "tex": "\\sisi{\\ar[u]_{s}}{\\ar[u]^{F_\\ast(s)}}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "F_{\\ast}(s)",
      "note": "The arrow between F_*(A) and F_*(A') is F_*(s), not s. The TeX corrects the label with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 300,
      "where": "Lemma 2.4.1.3, source category of \\Phi",
      "scan": "\\Aa_1",
      "tex": "\\Aa\\sisi{_1}{^1}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Aa^1",
      "note": "The source is the subcategory \\Aa^1 defined on the preceding page, not a fibre \\Aa_1. The TeX corrects the index with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 300,
      "where": "Construction of the quasi-inverse, source and target of f",
      "scan": "de but A, de source B",
      "tex": "de but\n$A$, de source $B$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "de but $B$, de source $A$",
      "note": "The source and target are interchanged: the diagram has f:A→B, and the subsequent F_*A^1 requires this direction. The TeX retains the printed reversal."
    },
    {
      "page": 300,
      "where": "Immediately before diagram (2.4.1.4), auxiliary object to be found",
      "scan": "B^1",
      "tex": "B\\sisi{^{1}}{'}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "B'",
      "note": "The auxiliary object is B', shown at the lower right of the diagram; B^1 was already fixed by the choice of s_B. The TeX corrects this with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 300,
      "where": "Immediately before diagram (2.4.1.4), name of the auxiliary morphism",
      "scan": "v et s\\in S^1",
      "tex": "\\sisi{$v$ et $s\\in S^{1}$}{$s\\in S^1$ et $u$}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$u$ et $s\\in S^1$",
      "note": "The prose names v, whereas the corresponding vertical arrow is labelled u. The TeX corrects the name with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 300,
      "where": "Diagram (2.4.1.4), the object labels A_1, F_*A_1 and B_1",
      "scan": "A_1,\\quad F_{\\ast}A_1,\\quad B_1",
      "tex": "A\\sisi{_1}{^1}; F_{\\ast}A\\sisi{_1}{^1}; B\\sisi{_1}{^1}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "A^1,\\quad F_{\\ast}A^1,\\quad B^1",
      "note": "The diagram incorrectly lowers the indices of the objects introduced as A^1 and B^1 in the text. The TeX corrects all three occurrences with \\sisi."
    },
    {
      "page": 300,
      "where": "Diagram (2.4.1.4), upper arrow labelled s_B",
      "scan": "B\\xrightarrow{s_B}B_1",
      "tex": "\\ar[r]_{s_B}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "B\\xleftarrow{s_B}B^1",
      "note": "The arrow points the wrong way: s_B was chosen with source B^1 and target B. The TeX retains the printed rightward direction."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "Counts (normal/misprint): 296: 0/1; 297: 1/0; 298: 1/4; 299: 0/3; 300: 0/7."
}
